title: Spanning local first-jet columns of an immersive generating system
statement: Let k be a field, f:Y -> Spec k smooth, L invertible, and s_0,...,s_r global sections generating L whose classified projective morphism is an immersion [def-weil-pbc-morphism-to-projective-space-by-sections]. For an open U with smooth relative dimension d and a point z in U, set K=kappa_U(z). Let Omega be the actual relative differential stalk fibre of U -> Spec k, as in [lem-pur-conormal-sequence-smooth-immersion]. There exist an open W of Y containing U.ι(z), a free generator e of L on W [def-sc-local-free-generator], and a K-linear equivalence Omega -> K^d. Write s_i|W=a_i e. Then the columns (a_i(z), da_i(z)) span K plus Omega. Values and differentials are taken after restriction along U.ι to U.ι^{-1}(W), using the actual universal relative derivation [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf]. Invertibility uses [def-sc-invertible-module]. No universal hypersurface or singular fibre is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0FD6, lemma-bertini, final paragraph; supplemented by Morphisms Tag 02G1 and Algebra Tag 00T7

proof.text: Use generatingSections_pair from lem-pc-complete-linear-system-closed and the standard projective chart cover to choose an index i whose chart contains the image of U.ι(z). Set W equal to its inverse image. The section-preserving isomorphism makes s_i restricted to W a free generator e. The coefficient a_j in this frame is exactly the pullback of the chart coordinate T_j/T_i, by map_eq_coordRatio_smul_of_twistRestrict_iso and coeff_eq_iff. In particular a_i=1. This constructs the frame directly; a separate fibre-generation criterion is unnecessary.

Compose the immersive projective morphism with U.ι. Both morphisms are surjective on stalks. The standard chart ring is generated as a k-algebra by its coordinate ratios: use closure_range_appLE_union_range_coordRatio and GammaSpecIso, putting constants and variables in the polynomial-evaluation range. Lift a source-stalk element to the projective stalk, express it as a fraction of chart sections by affine stalk localization, and lift the numerator and denominator to polynomials. The denominator remains a unit. The projective projection identity identifies the constant coefficients with the structure map on U; germ_stalkMap_apply and the coefficient identity identify all variable germs with the specified restricted a_j.

Apply lem-zl-differential-fibre-local-fractions to the restricted coefficient functions on U. Its proved polynomial-and-Leibniz argument shows their actual relative differential germs span the cotangent fibre, at the arbitrary residue-field point z. This replaces the local closed-immersion factorization and conormal exact-sequence argument.

Apply the proved isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_relativeDifferentials to U.ι ≫ f of smooth relative dimension d. Choose a local free trivialization and take its basis germs at z, using exists_basis_stalk_of_over_iso_free. Reindex from ULift(Fin d) to Fin d and apply Basis.baseChange to the actual identity-stalk residue algebra. The resulting basis.equivFun is the required equivalence of the differential fibre with kappa(z)^d. Empty bases handle d=0.

The i-th first-jet column is (1,0), since a_i=1 and d(1)=0. In the span P of all columns, scaling gives every (a,0). Subtract (a_j(z),0) from column j to get (0,da_j(z)). Span induction on the already spanning differential family gives every (0,m), and addition gives every pair (a,m). Reindexing the range from ULift(Fin(r+1)) to Fin(r+1) changes no generators.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0FD6, lemma-bertini, final paragraph; direct polynomial-fraction and Leibniz expansion of the omitted first-jet detail, using Constructions 01NE/01NF, Algebra 00RM/00RT and Morphisms 02G1. K1 proves the expansion without any new proof holes.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_bertiniLocalFirstJets
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f]
    (L : Y.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (r : ℕ)
    (s : ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)) → Γ(L, ⊤))
    (hgen : Epi (L.freeHomEquiv.symm (fun i ↦
      (SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv L) (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection L (s i)))))
    [IsImmersion (ProjectiveSpace.homOfGeneratingSections (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1))) f L
      (fun i ↦ (SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv L)
        (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection L (s i))) hgen)]
    (U : Y.Opens) (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (U.ι ≫ f)] (z : U) :
    ∃ (W : Y.Opens) (hz : U.ι z ∈ W) (e : Γ(L, W))
      (he : Scheme.Modules.IsFreeGenerator e)
      (b : bertiniCotangentFibre f U z ≃ₗ[(U : Scheme).residueField z]
        (Fin d → (U : Scheme).residueField z)),
      Submodule.span ((U : Scheme).residueField z)
        (Set.range (fun i : Fin (r + 1) ↦ bertiniLocalFirstJet f U z W hz
          (he.coeff (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op (s ⟨i⟩))))) = ⊤
